jobs.description:
Department of Clinical Sciences
Do you have clinical experience as a small animal veterinarian and are a board-certified specialist, or have equivalent qualifications, in animal reproduction? An opportunity has arisen to join the Small Animal Department at the University Animal Hospital (UDS), working with reproduction and general veterinary care in a setting closely integrated with research and the teaching of veterinary-and veterinary nursing students. We look forward to receiving your application!
About the position
As a licensed veterinarian and reproduction specialist at UDS, you will work at the Reproduction Clinic. The clinic provides diagnostic services and treatment for diseases of the reproductive organs, optimisation of mating timing, investigation and management of oestrus cycle disorders, fertility assessments, as well as semen collection and cryopreservation and artificial insemination (AI).
You will also participate in general veterinary care as part of the varied day-to-day activities at Sweden's only university animal hospital, which operates around the clock.
The position includes evening, night and weekend shifts. Our operations run 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
You will receive support from our specialists and experienced colleagues in the team, helping you to feel at home in the clinic and develop professionally in your role.
As SLU is Sweden's only institution providing higher education for animal health professionals, you will play an active role in educating the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of the future, both in the clinical setting and through other teaching activities in animal reproduction.
You will also devote some of your time to reproductive research, with opportunities to apply for your own research funding or participate in other research projects. Our reproductive research is highly active and encompasses all animal species and all aspects of reproduction. The Department has access to advanced laboratory techniques, enabling both in vivo and in vitro studies, and benefits from well-established national and international collaborations.
Your profile
You are a licensed veterinarian authorised to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden. You have several years of clinical experience working at a small animal clinic. You are a Diplomate and a specialist in animal reproduction, with a subspecialty in small animal reproduction (or have equivalent qualifications). We would like you to have experience as a reproduction veterinarian, with the skills required to perform routine procedures such as insemination, semen collection and cryopreservation.
As the position involves extensive contact with animal owners and students, you must have a good command of Swedish, both spoken and written, or have a good proficiency in English and be motivated to learn Swedish. The Department will support you in developing your Swedish language skills.
At the University Animal Hospital, we are customer-focused and committed to maintaining a professional approach characterised by goodwill and a positive attitude in our relationships with clients and colleagues. You are an effective communicator with the ability to establish and maintain good relationships with both clients and colleagues. You have an interest in teaching and in contributing to an environment that provides good conditions for research. As a veterinarian at the University Animal Hospital, you take a scientific approach to your work and have an interest in evidence-based veterinary medicine. You understand that working in an emergency service, where workloads are driven by unpredictable events and working hours are irregular, requires flexibility and adaptability.
As a person, you are well-organised, have good self-awareness and an understanding of what causes you stress, and are motivated to contribute to the organisation. In this recruitment process, great emphasis will be placed on your personal qualities and competencies.
About us
The Department of Clinical Sciences is responsible for undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in the fields of anaesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical chemistry, medicine and reproduction. Our activities in all these fields encompass all animal species.
At the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), University Animal Hospital (UDS), education, research and advanced veterinary care go hand in hand. 
Under one roof, we provide veterinary care for horses, dogs, cats and other small animals. In addition to modern facilities specifically designed for our operations, we have access to advanced diagnostic imaging equipment and a specialist veterinary diagnostic laboratory.
Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/
Location:
Uppsala, Sweden
Form of employment:
Indefinite-term employment. We use 6 months probationary employment.
Scope:
100%
Start date:
As agreed. 
Application:
Please submit your application before deadline 7 December 2026. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.
Please include in your application: 
Curriculum Vitae (CV)
Letter of intent
Copies of appropriate degree certificates

Union representatives:
https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/
 
 
The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

Job Description
As Unit Manager for Identity & Access Management (IAM), you will lead one of H&M Group’s most critical cyber security capabilities and play a key role in strengthening the organisation’s security, resilience and ability to deliver on its strategic ambitions. 
As a member of the Cyber Security Leadership Team reporting to the CISO, you will share accountability for the overall cyber security strategy, priorities and long-term development of the Cyber Security function. Working closely with leaders across business, technology and cyber security, you will help shape outcomes that balance business objectives, security needs and risk management across H&M Group. 
You will provide strategic leadership for H&M Group’s global IAM capability through an established leadership team spanning the end-to-end identity lifecycle. Through your leadership, you will drive the continued evolution of IAM, ensuring the capability remains effective, scalable and aligned with the future needs of the business. 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Lead the strategic direction, maturity and long-term development of H&M Group’s Identity & Access Management capability, defining and evolving the IAM strategy, roadmap and operating model in alignment with business, technology and cyber security objectives. 
Contribute as a member of the Cyber Security Leadership Team to the overall cyber security strategy, priorities, operating model and long-term capability development. 
Build strong partnerships with business, technology and cyber security stakeholders to drive alignment, influence decisions and enable strategic outcomes. 
Drive organisational effectiveness, workforce planning, capability development and succession planning within the IAM function. 
Ensure effective management of IAM-related risks, controls, regulatory obligations and strategic initiatives. 
Lead budgeting, resource and investment planning, vendor strategy and prioritisation to support delivery of IAM and cyber security objectives. 
Foster a high-performing, collaborative and inclusive culture focused on continuous improvement, innovation and business value. 

WHO YOU ARE
We are looking for people with:
8+ years of people management experience in cyber security, IAM or a closely related field. 
Proven experience leading an enterprise-scale IAM capability end to end in a global organisation, spanning governance, risk and compliance, architecture, engineering, delivery and operations. 
Proven experience leading through managers and developing high-performing leadership teams, with full ownership of a multidisciplinary organisation and its outcomes. 
Experience as a member of a senior cyber security, technology or enterprise leadership team, contributing to shared strategy, priorities, investment decisions and organisational outcomes beyond the individual’s own area of responsibility. 
Experience defining and executing enterprise IAM strategies, roadmaps, operating models and large-scale transformation, including organisational change across functional and organisational boundaries. 
Strong knowledge of IAM capabilities and technologies, including identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, authorisation and privileged access management, as well as enterprise IGA platforms such as Saviynt, SailPoint or similar. 
Strong knowledge of IAM-related risks, controls, policies, regulatory requirements and audit expectations. 
Experience managing significant budgets, investments, resources, sourcing arrangements and external partners, including leading negotiations with strategic vendors. 
Excellent communication and influencing skills, with proven experience engaging senior and executive stakeholders, clearly communicating strategic direction and translating complex IAM, cyber security and risk topics into business implications, priorities and decisions. 
Sound judgement and decision-making capability in complex, uncertain and risk-sensitive situations. 
Relevant certifications in IAM, cyber security or risk management are considered beneficial. 

Additional Information
This is a fulltime permanent role based in Stockholm, Sweden. 
If you believe your experience, skills, and ambitions align with this role, please submit your CV in English.
Diversity, Inclusion, and Innovation 
At H&M Group, we're deeply committed to fostering a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We actively seek out qualified candidates regardless of race, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, national origin, disability, or age. 
Our commitment to an inclusive workplace drives our dynamic and forward-thinking culture. Regardless of your background, origin, or preferences, your application is warmly welcomed. We value diverse perspectives and skills, and every applicant contributes to our vibrant, creative community. Join us and be part of the future we're building. 
Our Offer 
At H&M Group, you're not just joining a team – you're joining a value-driven culture and an expansive tech network. Enjoy perks like staff discount cards, flexible work arrangements, wellness benefits, parental support, and more. Here, you're encouraged to be yourself, experiment, and chart your own growth path. As you flourish, so do we, with opportunities to create tangible impacts and shape the future. 
WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  
We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET.

Are you ready to bring your innovative perspective and creative skills to ASAA ABLOY Business Segment Pedestrian (BSP) within the ASSA ABLOY Entrance Systems? Join our team in Landskrona, Sweden and enjoy a collaborative culture that empowers you to build a career you can be proud of.
What would you do as our Product Owner Revolving Doors.
As Product Owner for our Revolving Door product range, you assume full technical ownership of a comprehensive and established product line. Coordinating a multidisciplinary R&D team spanning hardware, firmware, and mechanical engineering, you will set priorities, drive alignment with portfolio priorities, and create the conditions in which engineers can perform and grow at their best.
 This position is well suited to a technically grounded person who combines hands-on engineering insight with the ability to coach a team, manage complexity, and drive results with discipline and clarity.
The role reports to Head of Security Entrance Control and Revolving Doors, and works closely with senior stakeholders across product management, manufacturing, quality, and global ASSA ABLOY divisions to drive innovation, performance, and long-term business impact.
You would also:
Oversee and develop a multidisciplinary R&D team — provide clear direction and hands-on management of hardware, firmware, and mechanical engineers; foster a culture of technical excellence, structured problem-solving, and continuous professional development, while coaching the team toward stronger resolution-making and greater ownership.
Own the full product development lifecycle — drive concept, validation, industrialisation, and ongoing lifecycle improvements, while ensuring consistent adherence to applicable safety and quality standards, including ISO, CE, EN16005, and UL.
Define and execute the R&D strategy — establish the product roadmap, ensure alignment with broader portfolio and business targets, manage R&D resources, budgets, and timelines, and embed sustainability principles across all stages of product development.
Drive innovation and the adoption of emerging technologies — identify opportunities to enhance product performance and design, stimulate creative thinking within the team, and evaluate the application of IoT, connectivity, AI, and other forward-looking technologies across the product range.
Represent the product externally and manage key stakeholder relationships — act as a credible technical ambassador in customer meetings, trade shows, and industry forums, while maintaining strong internal alignment with segment management, commercial product managers, and factory teams.

The skills and experience you need
We are looking for someone who has:
Engineering foundation — a degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related field, combined with a solid background in R&D for electromechanical products gained through hands-on engineering, product development, or early-career coordination roles.
Product lifecycle expertise — demonstrated experience managing the full development lifecycle, from concept and validation through to industrialisation and continuous improvement, with a strong understanding of systems, spare parts, and lifecycle stewardship.
Technical guidance skills— proven ability to lead and coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams, with the capacity to set direction, manage priorities, and drive delivery across hardware, firmware, and mechanical disciplines.
Compliance and quality awareness — familiarity with relevant safety and quality standards such as ISO, CE, EN16005, and UL, and a structured approach to process optimisation and regulatory adherence.
Domain knowledge and technology acumen — familiarity with revolving doors, door mechanics, drive systems, sensors, or embedded control units is a strong advantage. We equally welcome candidates who bring technical curiosity, analytical strength, and the motivation to grow into a product ownership role. An interest in emerging technologies such as IoT, connectivity, and AI is highly valued.

 
You are a natural leader who guides with clarity and purpose — someone who inspires confidence in a team not through authority alone, but through genuine engagement, consistent follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves when it matters. You think in possibilities, approaching technical tasks with creativity and a structured mind, always looking for smarter ways forward.
You are customer-centric by nature, with a keen sense of how engineering decisions translate into real-world impact — both for end users and for the business. You balance technical depth with pragmatic judgement, knowing when to dive into the details and when to step back and see the bigger picture. Proficiency in spoken and written English and Swedish is essential. Additional languages are a welcome advantage.
Above all, you act with integrity. You take ownership of your work and your team's outcomes, bring a safety-conscious mindset to every resolution, and hold yourself accountable to the highest standards — commercially, technically, and as a supervisor of people.

Learning and career development opportunities, whether it’s online learning, management training or enhancing your skills

What we do at Blykalla
Blykalla is a Swedish deep-tech company at the forefront of the nuclear industry, pioneering the development of small modular reactors that provide clean, safe, and reliable energy. Thanks to lead-cooling, we achieve high safety in a very compact format, allowing for a simple and cost-effective design that can be mass-produced. Our unique reactor design will provide safe and green baseload energy that perfectly complements solar and wind power.

What you’ll get to do
We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer with deep expertise in ABB 800xA DCS to lead the development of Blykalla's plant control system architecture and implementation strategy.
This is a unique opportunity to help define the control philosophy of a first-of-a-kind advanced nuclear reactor. You will play a key role in ensuring that Blykalla develops and retains ownership of critical control system intellectual property while working closely with ABB and other suppliers.

Key Responsibilities
DCS Architecture & Ownership
Lead the design and development of Blykalla's plant-wide automation and control system architecture.
Define the ABB 800xA system architecture for reactor, balance-of-plant, auxiliary, and test facility applications.
Develop internal engineering standards, libraries, templates, and control strategies to maximize in-house ownership of intellectual property.
Establish long-term governance for control system design, lifecycle management, cybersecurity, and configuration control.

Control System Engineering
Develop functional specifications, control narratives, cause-and-effect matrices, and automation philosophies.
Design and implement control logic, sequences, interlocks, alarms, and operator interfaces.
Configure ABB 800xA applications, controllers, engineering environments, and HMI systems.
Define communication architectures including OPC UA, IEC 61850, Modbus, Profibus/Profinet, Ethernet/IP, and other industrial protocols.
Develop and maintain simulation and testing environments for control system validation.

Nuclear Plant Integration
Support the integration of reactor systems, safety systems, and balance-of-plant equipment into the overall control architecture.
Work closely with reactor, thermal-hydraulic, electrical, mechanical, and safety engineers to define system requirements.
Contribute to licensing and regulatory documentation related to instrumentation and control systems.
Support development of digital I&C architectures aligned with nuclear industry expectations and international standards.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management
Act as the primary technical interface with ABB regarding 800xA architecture, licensing, engineering tools, and implementation support.
Ensure that Blykalla retains ownership of application software, engineering databases, configuration standards, and control strategies.
Manage external engineering partners and system integrators where required.
Participate in factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), commissioning, and startup activities.

Verification & Validation

Are you an experienced payment sales professional ready to combine commercial leadership with closing strategic deals yourself? Dintero is looking for a Head of Enterprise & Platforms Nordics to bring together its Nordic enterprise sales efforts, develop the team and drive growth across some of the company’s most important customer segments.
About the job
This is a direct recruitment, which means that the recruitment process takes place through Bravura and you are employed directly by Dintero.
About the company
Dintero is a fast-growing Norwegian fintech company challenging traditional payment providers with a modern, fully integrated payment platform. The company is one of few players in the Nordics covering the entire payment value chain and is licensed to process Visa and Mastercard transactions directly, making Dintero Norway’s first new acquirer in more than 20 years.
The offering covers online and in-store payments, Unified Commerce and payment solutions for platforms and marketplaces. With enterprise customers such as Vy and regulatory approval to offer payment services across the EEA, Dintero is positioned for further expansion across the Nordics and Europe. In 2025, the company onboarded more than 2,100 new businesses, increased payment volume by over 150% and revenue by 200%, while reaching profitability in Q4.
You will join a growing Nordic organisation with short decision paths and a high degree of ownership. There are established structures and processes, but these evolve as the business grows. Leaders are expected to identify what can be improved and actively contribute to developing how the organisation works.
Tasks and responsibilities
As Head of Enterprise & Platforms Nordics, you will have commercial responsibility for developing Dintero’s enterprise and platform sales across Sweden, Norway and Denmark. A key part of the role is to bring the three markets together and establish a common Nordic approach to sales, pipeline management and commercial priorities.

Alongside leading and developing the team, you will personally work with Dintero’s most strategic customers and drive complex enterprise opportunities from initial dialogue to signed agreement. You will also develop the existing sales team and play an active role in recruiting and building the team further across the Nordics, with the ambition to hire 3–5 additional salespeople during the first 12 months. You will work closely with the CEO, product and technical teams to develop Dintero’s enterprise offering. You are not expected to be a technical specialist, but you need to understand complex payment solutions and be comfortable discussing areas such as APIs, integrations and platform architecture.

Lead and develop Enterprise & Platforms sales across the Nordics

Coach and develop the existing sales team and recruit additional salespeople

Collaborate with leadership, product and technical teams to develop the enterprise offering

Proven experience closing complex, high-value enterprise deals in the Nordic market

Previous leadership experience, including people responsibility, coaching, developing and recruiting salespeople

Experience selling both in-store terminal solutions and online/e-commerce payments

Commercial and technical understanding of areas such as APIs and integrations and platform architecture

Existing network within Nordic enterprise retail

Fluent English and at least one Scandinavian language: Swedish, Norwegian or Danish

Experience selling through and building partnerships with e-commerce platforms and integration partners is meritorious

An existing network across marketplace or platform verticals is meritorious

You will work embedded with Marketing and build the AI systems, data, and agents that its teams run on. You will ship production software yourself, on Lovable, with the Applied AI engineers.

Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. And we’re just getting started.

We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

6+ years building and shipping production software or data systems that people depend on. Recent hands-on work in TypeScript, Python, or SQL.
Deep marketing knowledge from a marketing organization, a MarTech company, or a product or data role serving marketing teams. You know how paid and social channels, attribution, CRM, content, and positioning work in practice and where they break.

Senior stakeholder skills. You work directly with the CMO and Marketing leads, form your own view, and disagree in writing with a better path attached.
Care for permissions and data handling. Marketing systems touch customer data and spend. You treat access control as a design requirement from day one.

What you'll do
Run a listening tour with Marketing. Map current work, systems, data sources, owners, and the places where expert judgment lives. Propose builds only after that.
Agree each project with Marketing leadership up front: the problem, the metric, the owner, and the definition of done.
Connect the context a launch depends on: Linear tickets, internal docs, Slack threads, competitive intel, and usage data. When the scope changes, the change propagates to every asset that mentions it.
Build agents and workflows for Performance and Social: creative variants, campaign setup, and quality checks against brand guidance, with human review where spend or brand is at stake.
Encode Brand and Product Marketing judgment into systems: positioning, messaging, and voice guidance that other teams and agents apply without a meeting.
Connect Marketing's systems to the shared company data layer so agents and workflows can act on trusted data.
Build on the shared Applied AI foundation and contribute back. Reuse company data contracts, permissions, and agent patterns. Extract what Marketing needs into reusable pieces.
Launch every system with a named owner, a runbook, access rules, and a review cadence. Teach the Marketing team to operate it without you.
Measure results with Marketing and use them to decide what to improve, extend, or retire.
Bring concrete product gaps from internal use to Lovable's product teams.

How the role fits
You report into Applied AI and spend most of your time with Marketing. Marketing leadership sets the priorities and owns the results. You agree with them on what to build, how to measure it, and who owns each system once it runs. Applied AI owns the shared foundations you build on: company data contracts, permissions, the information architecture and reusable agent patterns.
You work day to day with the Applied AI engineers and with colleagues embedded in Sales, Finance, People, and Support. A capability you build for Marketing often becomes a building block for another function, and the reverse is true too.
Our tech stack

Languages: TypeScript, Python, SQL, Go
AI: Anthropic, OpenAI, MCP, AI agents

Minds and makers forging ahead together.

Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, control and real-world operations.You will join a highly technical and ambitious team at an exciting point in the company's journey. As we continue to scale our engineering team and work on challenging new projects, you will have the opportunity to influence how our embedded and control software develops.This is a role where your software will not remain behind a screen. You will see it integrated with real hardware, tested on real systems and used in demanding real-world environments.You will work closely with talented engineers, take meaningful technical ownership and help shape the next generation of Robotto's technology.

Equal Employment Opportunity:
Robotto is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience and potential. Please note that certain positions may require specific nationality or eligibility for security clearance in accordance with applicable laws and the nature of our work.

jobs.occupation: Business Development & Sales Manager to Xenergic
jobs.description:
What if one of the key challenges in tomorrow’s most advanced chips could be solved by technology developed in Lund? Xenergic is growing its international business and is now looking for a Business Development & Sales Manager to turn technical opportunities into strategic partnerships and long-term business.
YOU WILL
Xenergic is a Lund-based semiconductor company developing high-speed, On-chip memory IP IP for advanced chip technologies. With a strong technical foundation in place, we are now increasing our commercial focus and building relationships with leading semiconductor companies worldwide.
You will play a central role in building Xenergic’s international business and turning technical opportunities into long-term commercial partnerships. Working closely with the CEO, CTO and Engineering Manager, you will combine customer development and sales with a strong understanding of technology, products and where the market is heading.
This is not a traditional sales role. Xenergic operates in complex semiconductor markets with long business cycles, where understanding the customer’s architecture, technical challenges, product roadmap and decision process is essential. You will work with both engineering teams and commercial decision-makers and take personal ownership of moving opportunities from early dialogue and technical qualification through evaluation and negotiation to commercial agreement and design win.
The role is hands-on. You will actively identify and approach potential customers, develop relationships and follow opportunities over time. You will also bring customer and market insights back into Xenergic, helping the management team understand where the strongest commercial opportunities are and how customer needs should influence value proposition and product priorities. An important part of the role will also be to develop Xenergic’s international reach through selected local sales representatives and partners in key semiconductor markets. Your main responsibilities:
Identify and develop strategic customers and new business opportunities in key semiconductor markets.
Own and drive customer opportunities from prospecting and technical qualification through evaluation and commercial negotiation to signed licence agreement and design win.
Build long-term relationships with engineering teams, technical decision-makers and commercial stakeholders.
Understand customer architecture, use cases and memory requirements and translate these into relevant market and product input for Xenergic.
Build Xenergic’s international commercial coverage through selected sales representatives and partners, with particular focus on Silicon Valley, Taiwan, South Korea, Japan and Europe.
Contribute customer and market insights to Xenergic’s commercial direction, value proposition and product priorities together with the CEO, CTO and Engineering Manager.

The role reports to the CEO and is part of the management team, with overall responsibility for Business Development & Sales. Extensive international travel is an important part of the role, with approximately 100 travel days per year expected, primarily to customers, partners and key semiconductor markets in North America, Asia and Europe.
YOU ARE 
Your career has given you a strong understanding of the semiconductor industry and brought you close to both technology and business. Perhaps you started on the technical side and gradually moved towards Product Management, Business Development, Strategic Sales or another customer-facing commercial role. What matters is that you can move comfortably between technical discussions and commercial opportunities.
You have a technical university degree, preferably in electronics, electrical engineering, engineering physics, computer engineering or a related field, together with relevant experience from semiconductor IP, SoC, processors or accelerators, EDA, foundry or related advanced chip technologies.
You have a proven commercial track record in complex B2B technology environments and have personally driven opportunities from early technical dialogue and qualification through negotiation to signed agreement or design win. You are technically credible enough to engage with chip architects, SoC designers and engineering managers, while keeping a clear commercial focus.
You are curious, hands-on and comfortable opening new doors, developing relationships and taking responsibility for moving opportunities forward. You enjoy working in an entrepreneurial environment and do not need a large sales or pre-sales organisation around you to create momentum.
Experience combining Product Management with Business Development or Sales is particularly relevant. Experience from On-chip Memory IP, semiconductor IP licensing, NRE and royalty-based business models, the foundry ecosystem or international sales representatives is considered an advantage.
You are comfortable representing a smaller technology company internationally and building relationships with significantly larger organisations. Fluency in English is required, as is the willingness and ability to travel extensively internationally.
At Xenergic, you will join at a stage where technology, market opportunity and commercial growth come together. Short decision paths and close collaboration with the management team give you the opportunity to directly influence which customers, markets and partnerships Xenergic pursues as the company grows internationally.
WANT TO KNOW MORE? 
In this recruitment, Xenergic is collaborating with Nexer Recruit. For questions about the role or the recruitment process, contact Johanna Värmfors at johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com or +46 723 61 28 44.
ABOUT XENERGIC
Xenergic is a Swedish semiconductor technology company based in Lund, developing high-speed, On-chip memory IP for advanced semiconductor applications.
Its technology addresses important challenges in modern chip design, where performance, power consumption and silicon area are becoming increasingly important. Xenergic’s solutions are relevant for applications ranging from IoT and mobile devices to networking, high-performance computing and AI.
Xenergic combines deep semiconductor expertise with a specialised engineering organisation and an international market. As we grow our commercial presence, joining Xenergic means becoming part of a small technology company where your work and ideas can have a real impact.
